title: Terms & Conditions
text:
Use of Website

By accessing and using Vape Shop Australia, you agree to comply with these terms and conditions. All content, products, and services provided on this website are for lawful use only. You must be of legal age to purchase vape products in Australia. Misuse of the website, including fraudulent activity or unauthorized access, is strictly prohibited.

Orders and Payments

All orders placed through Vape Shop Australia are subject to acceptance and availability. Prices for vapes, disposable vapes, vape kits, vape pods, e-liquids, and nicotine vapes are listed in Australian dollars and may change without notice. Payments must be completed in full before orders are processed and dispatched.

Shipping and Delivery

Vape Shop Australia aims to process and ship orders promptly. Delivery times may vary depending on location and courier services. We are not responsible for delays caused by third-party couriers, incorrect addresses, or failed delivery attempts. Risk of loss passes to the customer once the order is dispatched.

Returns and Liability

All sales are subject to our refund policy. Vape Shop Australia is not liable for misuse of vape products or individual reactions to e-liquids or nicotine vapes. Customers are responsible for ensuring products are used correctly and in accordance with applicable laws and regulations in Australia.
